deskyard cursor: print the mouse position

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] cursor

Prints where the mouse pointer is.

Prints: one line "X Y", e.g. "640 400"

Examples:
  deskyard cursor

Where: inside an environment it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen environment (-e NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
